Heals all allies within 4 grids of the caster once.

Heals 1 ally within 4 grids of the caster once. The effect then chains to 1 random ally within 4 grids of the target, up to 5 times. Repeated healing on the same target is diminished by 35% per instance.
Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 50% chance to deal additional Light DMG once, with a 30% base chance to inflict Blind.

Deals Light DMG once to 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster, then bounces to a random enemy within 3 grids of that target, bouncing up to 5 times. When the caster has 5 or more stacks of Charge, consumes 5 stacks of Charge to increase this Technique's DMG by 50%. If the same target is hit again, the DMG dealt is reduced by 40% successively. (Can hit large targets multiple times)
Increases the caster's DMG RES. When taking Technique DMG, there's a 50% chance to teleport to any empty grid within 4 grids of the caster. Can trigger only once per turn.
Increases the DMG dealt by the caster's Laceration. When a Technique strikes an enemy target from a normal state into Airborne, triggers Laceration once.
Deals Water DMG once to all enemies within 3 grids of the caster, with a 40% base chance to knock them back by 1 grid towards the caster.
Has a 20% chance to inflict Burn to grids within range when casting a Fire Technique.
Increases the caster's Elemental Mastery. At the start of battle, reduces the CD of all Techniques by 1 turn. (Techniques already off cooldown are not affected.)
Each time the caster blocks an enemy's Technique attack, deals Physical DMG once to the attacker based on the caster's DEF.
While shielded, the caster reflects a percentage of DMG taken back to the attacker as Light DMG once for each Technique attack received.
Carries 3 potions at the start of battle. When an allied character's HP falls below 50%, uses a potion to heal them. Produces 1 potion every 3 turns, holding up to 3 at a time.
Heals 1 ally within 5 grids of the caster once. If the target's HP is below 50%, this healing effect is increased by 20%.
Increase the caster's SPD for each enemy unit killed. Stacks up to 4 times.
Selects a grid within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Wind DMG 4 times to all enemies within 1 grid of the target grid and knocks them Airborne.

Has a 75% chance to trigger Repelling Wind when an enemy actively enters within 2 grids of the caster, dealing Wind DMG once, with a 100% base chance to knock them back 2 grids. (Triggers again if they approach repeatedly)
Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster and reduces the enemy's SPD by 10% for 1 turn.

When an allied adventurer dies, immediately revives and heals them once, granting Revitalization for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled). This Charm can only trigger once per battle. At the start of battle, if multiple allied adventurers are dead, reviving the one with the highest Power first.

Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster, then bounces to another random enemy within 3 grids up to 4 times. 30% base chance to inflict Stun for 1 turn when dealing damage. (Large targets may take multiple hits.)
At the start of the caster's turn, reduces Effect RES of all enemies within 5 grids of the caster. This effect is unique. Also there's a 50% base chance to inflict Vulnerability for 1 turn.
When the caster's shield is fully broken, deals Water DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster, with a 100% base chance to inflict 3 stacks of Cold for 2 turns.
Attacks 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster, dealing Water DMG once with a 40% base chance to inflict Stun for 1 turn.

The first time the caster takes lethal DMG, the caster survives with 1 HP and enters the Risen from Flame state. Absorbs all Burn inflicted by allies within 3 grids of the caster, granting the caster 1 Shield based on the caster's max HP per Burn absorbed, lasting until the Risen from Flame state ends.
Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster.
Summons 1 Rock Rex in front of the caster. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats. (The Technique can only trigger once per battle.)
Selects a target within 4 grids of the caster. Deals Water DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target.

Activates Prism Armor for 2 turns, which cannot be dispersed. While active, each time the caster takes Technique DMG, counters by dealing Light DMG once to the attacker based on the caster's DEF. (Zero Initial CD)
From the caster's 3rd turn onward, increases DMG dealt at the start of each turn. Stacks up to 3 times.
Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Light DMG once to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the target grid.
Each time the caster heals an ally with a Technique, has a 50% chance to grant them DMG taken reduction for 1 turn. This effect is unique.
Enters the Sanctification state for 2 turns, reducing DMG taken by the caster and all allied characters within 4 grids of the caster. The effect is unique and cannot be dispelled. (Zero Initial CD)

Each Technique cast grants a stack of Battle Zeal and increases the caster's ATK. At 6 stacks, Battle Zeal converts to Scarlet Zeal, greatly increasing the caster's ATK for 2 turns. (Battle Zeal doesn't stack while Scarlet Zeal is active.)
Teleports to an empty grid adjacent to the lowest-HP enemy within 5 grids of the caster, then deals Fire DMG once to that target.
Deals Fire DMG once to all enemies within a 3-grid circular range of the caster, with a 40% chance to inflict Burn on the terrain.
Deals Fire Doom DMG once to all enemies within a 3x1 grid area in front of the caster.
Deals Water DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster.

At the end of the caster's turn, gains 1 stack of Shadow. At 2 stacks, the effect triggers, healing the caster once and granting Stealth. Lasts 1 turn and cannot be removed. (Shadow stacks do not increase while Stealth is active.)

Teleports to an empty grid adjacent to 1 enemy within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Dark DMG once to the target. Killing the target triggers this skill again. Can be cast up to 4 additional times per turn.
Each time the caster's Technique deals Dark DMG to an enemy, there is a 40% base chance to inflict Erosion.
Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of that target grid. If the enemy target carries Erosion, triggers Erosion effect twice immediately.
Deals Dark DMG once to 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster. If the target carries Erosion, triggers all Erosion stacks immediately. (Prioritizes large targets)

Leaps to any empty grid within 3 grids of the caster, dealing Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster, with a 50% base chance to inflict Weakened 1 for 2 turns, and pulls them to the caster's surroundings.

Upon taking lethal DMG for the first time, the caster survives with 1 HP and enters Shadow Form, lasting until the end of the caster's turn (cannot be dispelled). In this form, the caster is immune to all DMG, can't be healed, won't be the primary target of attacks, deals increased DMG, and reduces Technique CD by 2 turns. (The caster dies immediately if failing to win when Shadow Form ends, ignoring any effects that would preserve HP.)
Within a single turn, each time the caster loses over 10% of max HP, reduces DMG taken and increases SPD for 2 turns. Stacks up to 5 times.
Increases the caster's Dark DMG. Killing an enemy deals additional Dark DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of the target.

Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 40% chance to generate a Wind Orb near the caster. At the end of the caster's turn, the caster selects a target within 4 grids. Each Wind Orb then attacks that target, dealing Wind DMG once. (Max Wind Orbs: 10)
Attacks 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster, dealing Physical DMG 3 times, with a 60% base chance to inflict 1 stack of Riven Heart for 1 turn. Stacks up to 3 times. (Prioritizes large targets)
When a target frozen by the caster removes the Frozen state, additionally deals Water DMG once.
Attacks 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster, dealing Fire DMG once and inflicting Sigil. (Prioritizes large targets)
Increases the caster's Elemental Mastery. Up to 2 Magic Sigils per element, with a maximum of 5 existing at once.
Deals Physical DMG 6 times to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster.

Attacks 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster, dealing Light DMG once, then bounces to a random enemy within 3 grids of it, up to 5 bounces. When the caster has 5 or more stacks of Charge, consumes 5 stacks of Charge to increase this Technique's DMG by 50%. If it hits the same target repeatedly, the DMG dealt is reduced by 40% successively. (Can hit large targets multiple times)
Increases the caster's Light affinity. At the end of the caster's turn, gains 2 stacks of Charge, stacking up to 20 stacks, which cannot be dispersed.
Attacks 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster, dealing Physical Doom DMG once, with a 150% base chance to inflict Stun for 1 turn. (Prioritizes large targets)
Selects a grid within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Fire DMG once to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the target grid, and inflicts Burn on the grid. (Prioritizes large targets)
Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster.
Deals Fire DMG 3 times to all enemies within a 1-grid square area around the caster, then deals Fire DMG once to all enemies within a 2-grid circular area around the caster. (Zero Initial CD)
Increase the caster's DMG dealt for every 15% HP lost of the target. Stacks up to 5 times.
When the caster's summon dies or expires, deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of it.
Grants an ATK boost when the caster has a summon on the battlefield.
Deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 3×2 grid area in front of the caster, with a 10% Lifesteal effect.
At the start of battle, converts 50% of the caster's current HP into a shield. Restores HP proportional to the remaining shield strength upon victory.
Deals Dark DMG twice to 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster. For every 5% HP lost by the target, this skill deals 5% more DMG, up to a max of 50% increase. (Prioritizes large targets)
Increases the ATK of the caster's summons but reduces their duration by 2 turns. (Summons last at least 1 turn; this Charm does not affect summons without a turn limit.)
The caster's Single-Hit Techniques deal more DMG. Killing an enemy deals additional Fire DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target. The DMG dealt is 60% of the overkill DMG.
When the caster's summon dies or expires, heals the caster once.
At the start of battle, consumes 50% of the caster's current HP to grant the caster a DMG Reduction effect. This effect cannot be dispelled.

When 3 of the caster's summons die or disappear, summons 1 Infernal Fiend in front of the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats. (The Charm can only trigger once per battle.)
Heals the caster once at the start of the caster's turn.
Selects a grid within 2 grids of the caster. Deals Physical DMG 4 times to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the target grid.
Grants Spirit Mark to the allied character with the lowest HP within 5 grids of the caster.

Increases the caster's Erosion DMG. Each time the caster casts a Technique and deals Dark DMG to an enemy, if the target is afflicted with Erosion, the Erosion effect immediately triggers 1 time with a 100% chance.
During battle, the first summon with an unlimited duration that the caster summons takes reduced DMG and deals increased DMG.

When a summon with a turn-limited duration dies or disappears, grants 1 Shield based on the caster's max HP to 1 summon with an unlimited duration for 2 turns. (This Charm only affects the caster's own summons)
For each Potion the caster holds, increases the healing the caster provides. Potion creation speed rises by 1 every 2 turns, and increases the healing from the caster's Potions by 50%.
Every 3 turns, increases the DMG dealt by the caster's Blast Spirit once, up to 2 times, which cannot be dispelled. The caster's Blast Spirit gains an effect upgrade.
Reduces DMG taken during the caster's turn.
When the caster's summon ends its turn, deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of it.
Deals Physical DMG once to 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster. (Prioritizes large targets)
At the start of the caster's turn, the caster gains 2 stacks of Edge Will. Stacks up to 4 times and cannot be removed.
Selects a grid within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Light DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target grid, with a 30% base chance to inflict Blind.
Deals Fire DMG to the lowest-HP enemy within 1 grid of the caster. For every 10% of HP the target has lost, this skill's DMG increases by 20%, up to a maximum of 200%.
Reduces the caster's DMG taken for 1 turn for every 1 instance of Technique DMG the caster takes. This effect can stack up to 9 times.
Summons a Stonechief in front of the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats and remains for up to 5 turns. (Zero Initial CD)

Selects a grid within 5 grids of the caster. Deals Wind DMG 3 times to all enemies within 3 grids of the target grid with a 35% base chance to knock them back by 1 grid towards the center of the battlefield.
Increases the caster's Physical Mastery.
Attacks 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster, dealing Physical DMG once, with a 40% base chance to inflict Stun for 1 turn.

Summons 1 Flame Dragon in front of the caster, which acts immediately. The summon inherits a portion of the caster's stats, enters Stealth, and can exist on the battlefield for up to 3 turns. (Zero Initial CD)
Summons 1 Shadow beside the caster, which acts immediately. The summon inherits a portion of the caster's stats. (Can only be cast once per battle)
Summons 1 Flower Spirit behind the caster and makes it act immediately. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats. It is in Stealth and remains on the field for up to 3 turns. (Standby)
Summons 1 Spirit Armor near an enemy within 4 grids of the caster and makes it act immediately. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats. (This Technique activates only once per battle)
Increases the ATK of summons.
Increases the ATK of the caster's summons. At the start of the caster's turn, advances the action of 1 random summon of the caster's within 5 grids by 30%.
Summoning consumes 2% of the caster's max HP to increase the summon's HP. Restores all HP consumed by this Charm if the caster survives until victory.
Deals Physical DMG 5 times to all enemies in a 3×2 grid area in front of the caster.
Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Water DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target grid, with a 40% base chance to inflict Wet for 2 turns.

Increases the caster's Elemental RES. Each time the caster takes Technique DMG, has a chance to trigger Surging Tide, advancing the caster's action by 20%, up to 2 times per turn. The trigger chance starts at 0% and increases by 5% for each equipped Technique that deals Water DMG.
Deals Water DMG once to all enemies within 3 grids of the caster.
Increases the caster's SPD. At the end of the caster's turn, has a 40% chance to reduce the cooldown of 1 random Technique on cooldown by 1 turn.
When the caster moves of their own accord, inflicts 1 stack of Laceration for 1 turn on all enemies within 1 grid of the caster. Stacks up to 3 times.
Attacks 1 enemy within 1 grid of the caster, dealing Water DMG once and converting 20% of the DMG dealt into a shield (up to 50% of the caster's max HP) for the caster for 2 turns.
When there are 3 or fewer enemies within 2 grids, increases the caster's DMG dealt. When there are more than 3 enemies within 2 grids, reduces the caster's DMG taken.
Each time the caster's Technique deals Crit DMG to an enemy, causes additional Wind DMG once.
Deals Wind DMG 5 times to 1 enemy within 3 to 5 grids of the caster.
Before battle begins, the caster's ability awakens, reducing the DMG the caster takes. Additionally, until the end of the caster's 2nd turn, this effect is increased by 200%.
Summons 1 Thalasson next to the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats. (The Technique can only trigger once per battle.)
Deals Light DMG 3 times to 1 enemy within 5 grids of the caster. (Prioritizes large targets)
Deals Light DMG 3 times to 1 enemy within 5 grids of the caster. (Prioritizes large targets)
Each time the caster's Technique deals Light DMG to an enemy, there is a 65% base chance to inflict Electro.

Randomly releases 8 ball lightnings within a 3x5 grid range in front of the caster, each dealing Light DMG once and conducting to a random enemy within 2 grids. (The skill prioritizes including large targets within its range)
Each time the caster takes Technique DMG, gains 1 stack of Tidal Sigil. When it stacks to 15, counters by dealing Water DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the caster based on the caster's DEF.

Each time the caster casts 5 Water Techniques, the caster enters the Torrent state for 2 turns, which cannot be dispelled. During this state, the caster's DMG dealt is increased, and after each Technique cast, has a 30% chance to reset its cooldown and cast it again, up to 2 times per turn. (Techniques cast during the Torrent state do not count toward the tally)
Increases the caster's HP.

Summons a Treantling behind the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats, but cannot be the primary target of attacks or healing. It remains for up to 5 turns. (Zero Initial CD)

Every 8 Dark Techniques cast, the caster enters Communion for 2 turns, which cannot be dispersed. During Communion, the caster's DMG dealt is increased, and DMG dealt by Techniques gains a 10% Lifesteal effect. (Techniques cast during Communion do not count toward the tally)
Deals Wind DMG twice to 1 enemy within 3 to 5 grids of the caster.
Applies a Shield based on the caster's DEF to the caster and to the lowest-HP ally within 5 grids of the caster for 2 turns each.
Reduces DMG taken by the caster. At the end of the caster's turn, immediately triggers 1 instance of the caster's own Erosion effect within 5 grids of the caster.

At the start of battle, grants Unity to all allied characters within a 3-grid square area of the caster, including the caster. Only the highest-value instance of the same effect is active, and it cannot be removed.
When the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, there's a 25% chance to trigger Aura, dealing additional Wind DMG once, with a 60% base chance to knock them back by 1 grid.
Grants a DMG Boost to all allied characters within 5 grids of the caster for 2 turns and dispels 1 random status ailment or debuff. (Casts once before battle starts.)
At the start of the caster's turn, gains 1 stack of Rhythm if the caster's HP is above 30%. This effect stacks up to 5 times and cannot be dispelled.

Selects a grid within 4 grids of the caster. Increases max HP of all allied characters within 2 grids of the target grid by a percentage of the caster's Max HP for 3 turns. This effect is unique. If the target's HP is below 30%, additionally performs a 5% healing. (Casts once before battle starts.)
When the caster's HP drops below 50% for the first time in a battle, grants a shield to the caster based on max HP for 2 turns and Dodge for 2 turns (cannot be dispelled).

Creates a magic rune that lasts 2 turns. When an enemy within 5 grids casts a Technique, the rune deals Dark DMG once to them. If the target carries Erosion, triggers the Erosion effect once. (Zero Initial CD)
Attacks 1 enemy within 3 grids of the caster, dealing Dark DMG twice, with a 40% base chance to inflict Erosion.
Increases the caster's Wind affinity. Each time the caster's Technique deals DMG to an enemy, has a 10% base chance to Knockback 1 grid.

Deals Light DMG once to all enemies within a 1x7 grid range in front of the caster. When hitting the same target repeatedly, DMG dealt is reduced by 40% from the 3rd hit onward. (Can hit large targets multiple times)
Increases the caster's ATK.
Deals Water DMG once to all enemies in a 3×4 grid area in front of the caster. DMG decreases by 25% for each subsequent hit on the same target. (Large targets may take multiple hits.)
Deals Water DMG once to 1 enemy within 4 grids of the caster.
When the caster's Technique deals Water DMG to an enemy, there's a 50% chance to trigger Condensation, dealing additional Water DMG once, with a 30% base chance to inflict Frozen for 1 turn.

Summons a Waterling behind the caster that immediately acts. The summon inherits a percentage of the caster's stats, but cannot be the primary target of attacks or healing. It remains for up to 5 turns. (Zero Initial CD)
Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within 2 grids of the target grid, with a 50% base chance to inflict Weakened 1 for 2 turns.
Deals Physical DMG 4 times to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the caster.

Deals Physical DMG 3 times to all enemies within a 3x1 grid area in front of the caster, with the final hit having a 50% base chance to knock them back 1 grid. For every 5% the caster's DEF exceeds the target's, the DMG dealt by this skill increases by 5%, up to 50%.
Deals Wind DMG once to all enemies in a 1×4 grid area in front of the caster, with a 50% base chance to knock them back by 1 grid.
Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Wind DMG 3 times to all enemies within a 1-grid square area of the target grid, with a 40% base chance to inflict Laceration for 1 turn.
Creates 4 Wind Orbs around the caster.

Selects a grid within 6 grids of the caster. Launches 7 waves of wind blades at the target grid and random enemies within 1 grid to the target grid's left and right. Each wave deals Wind DMG once to all enemies within 1 grid of the enemy target. DMG decreases by 35% for each subsequent hit on the same target.
Has a 30% chance to deal additional Wind DMG once and a 50% base chance to delay the target's action by 20% after dealing Wind DMG 3 times to an enemy with Techniques.
Increases the caster's Wind DMG.
Increase DMG dealt by the caster's Wind Orbs. Each time a Wind Orb is generated, there's a 70% chance to generate another, up to 4 times per turn.
Selects a grid within 3 grids of the caster. Deals Dark DMG once to all enemies within a 2-grid cross area of the target grid, with a 50% base chance to inflict Weakened 1 for 2 turns.

Deals 1 instance of Anemo DMG to all enemy targets within a 1x3 radius in front of the caster. If the caster's speed is higher than any of the targets, there is a 60% chance to cast this skill again up to a maximum of 2 additional casts per turn.

Deals 1 instance of Pyro DMG to one enemy target within 1 tile of the user. While in stealth mode, this skill does 1 instance of Pyro DMG to the enemy with the lowest DEF within a 7 tile radius of the user.
Deals 1 instance of Dark DMG to all enemy targets within a 3x2 grid in front of the caster. In Reaper form, this skill grants a 50% life steal effect.
Apply the Blazing mark to yourself and 7 random friendly characters within a 4 tile radius, lasting 2 turns.
Jump to any open space within 4 tiles of yourself and deal 1 instance of Anemo DMG to all enemy targets within a cross shaped area 1 tile in front of you.

Jump to any open space within 4 squares of yourself and deal 1 instance of Dark DMG to all enemy targets within a 3x2 square range in front of you. In Reaper form, the DMG dealt by this skill is increased by 50%.

Starting from the caster's own turns, at the beginning of every seventh of the caster's turn, the caster enters Reaper state, lasting for 4 turns, which cannot be dispelled. During this time, Dark Skill DMG is increased.

Each time a combat skill deals physical DMG to an enemy, it applies 1 stack of Soul Shatter. After each stack, there is a 15% chance to consume all stacks to deal physical DOOM DMG with the DMG increasing based on the stack number.
Increases own Wind Affinity. Your own Wind Orbs deal DMG to the target. Afterwards, it can deal DMG again to one random ennemy within 4 squares of the location where the DMG took place.
While in stealth, the DMG taken is reduced. At the start of your turn, if you are in stealth, randomly dispel one negative effect.
When unleashing a combat skill, there is a 50% chance to create 3 Wind Orbs around the user whenever an attack deals Wind DMG to an enemy target.

Each time a combat skill deals Dark DMG to an enemy target, there is a 70% chance to apply 1 stack of shadow mark. When shadow mark stacks to 2, it triggers, dealing Dark DMG to all enemy targets within 1 tile square area of the damage location.
